heading_en: Approval Before the Application Date for the Expected Exposure Method
summary_ja: 期待エクスポージャー方式の使用承認を適用日前に申請・承認でき、適用日に承認されたものとみなす。
summary_en: Approval to use the expected exposure method may be applied for and granted before the Application Date and is deemed granted on that date.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company may, even before the Application Date, in accordance with Article 50 of the New Public Notice, apply for approval for the use of the expected exposure method (meaning calculating the credit equivalent amount as provided in Article 49 of the New Public Notice).

Where an application has been made pursuant to the preceding paragraph before the Application Date, the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency may grant approval in accordance with Article 49, paragraph (1) of the New Public Notice. In this case, that approval is deemed to have been granted on the Application Date pursuant to that paragraph.
